_README: Hand-annotated ground truth for the Red Herring Prospectus.
SCOPE: text units 468-606 inclusive - the 'GENERAL INFORMATION' section.
This section was chosen because it is where the document concentrates its
personal data: registered and corporate offices, the company secretary's
direct contact details, both book running lead managers, the registrar,
the legal counsel, the bankers to the offer and the statutory auditors.
WHY A SCOPE AT ALL: annotating all 4,686 paragraphs by hand is not
feasible, and evaluating whole-document predictions against a partial
annotation would count every correct detection made outside the annotated
region as a false positive. Restricting both sides to the same region is
The section was annotated EXHAUSTIVELY: every entity of every supported
type inside it is listed, including ones the tool is known to miss, so
recall is not flattered by omitting hard cases.
NOT ANNOTATED AS PII, deliberately: CIN, SEBI registration numbers, firm
registration numbers and peer review numbers. These identify companies and
filings, not people. See README 'What is not treated as PII'.
